name: CK Power Public Company Limited
summary: CK Power Public Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, generates and sells electricity and steam in Thailand and Lao People's Democratic Republic. It operates through three segments: Generation of Electricity from Hydroelectric Power, Generation of Electricity from Solar Power, Generation of Electricity from Thermal Power. The company operates 3 hydro power plants with a capacity of 3,360 megawatts (MW); 13 solar power plants with a capacity of 42 MW; and 2 cogeneration power plants with installed capacity of 238 MW.
